correctness.rationale: The nine column states and the forward oriented diagonal charge precisely the specified bonds; field hits and the rung may be booked at either endpoint of each transition since the word is closed. I independently enumerated all 125,673 elementary directed cycles, including loops, using the rung and field terms at the departing rather than arriving column. Every closed walk decomposes into elementary cycles and its mean is a length-weighted average of their means. At h=0,1,2 the exact minimum cycle means are 0,-2/3,-2. Each cycle has affine energy in h, so interpolation gives the two bounded-field lower lines, and its field-hit mean is at most 2, giving the final lower line for h>=2. The two period-three words have (bond,hit) means (0,2/3) and (2/3,4/3), and the constant (0,1) word gives (2,2). They attain the three respective branches for every 3|n. Padding a minimizing periodic word by at most two columns changes finitely many terms, giving the claimed limit for all lengths at each fixed h. For counts, optimal walks are exactly the closed walks in the graph of edges on optimal elementary cycles: shifting edge costs by the minimum mean gives no negative cycle, so shortest-path potentials from an auxiliary source give nonnegative reduced costs; all edges on optimal cycles have zero reduced cost. The graph of optimal elementary cycles is constant on each open interval because a nonnegative affine cycle gap cannot vanish at an interior point unless identically zero there. The five exact characteristic polynomials of these cyclic-edge graphs agree with the frozen table; the h=0 polynomial also agrees with the first regime. trace(A^n) counts words with fixed column labels, not rotation classes. At h=1 and n=3k the trace is 3(phi^(2k)+phi^(-2k))=3L_(2k). At h=2 the cubic companion is nonnegative, strongly connected and has a loop; its Perron root 2.1478990357 strictly dominates the other roots in modulus. Dividing log counts by 2n yields the stated two entropy limits and zero on the strict phases. This calculation independently verifies the cycle bounds and cyclic counts; audited claims do not rely on the recorded six-column experiment.
residual_risks: Exact finite-size energies and multiplicities are commensurate-length statements; other lengths have only the asserted energy-density limit. No positive-temperature singularity is established.

value.rationale: Incompatible row preferences are a natural inhomogeneous-field extension of the standard width-two antiferromagnetic cylinder. The exact magnetic energy envelope is valid over the full field axis, and the two critical counts expose distinct exponential growth laws separated by bounded multiplicity phases. This supplies an exact zero-temperature benchmark for local-field methods, going beyond a few finite samples or the computation of a single transfer eigenvalue.
residual_risks: The benchmark concerns a fixed strip width and equal strengths of the two preferences; it does not extrapolate to two-dimensional limits or arbitrary field patterns.
